Four are packet-prepared documents that are neither rendered nor disclosed as something the participant obtains: (1) the proposed order, which LA-IMM-01 also requires to 'expressly address the current restriction and court-record sealing duties' for a discharge entered on or after July 1, 2026; (2) the hearing-request election; (3) the certificate of service or local notice document; (4) the post-order restriction, sealing and verification instructions.
